title (required): Why Uber Leaving Lagos Is Bigger Than Ride-Hailing
excerpt: The exit says more about unit economics than ride-hailing.
body:
Uber's quiet retreat from Lagos is read as a defeat. It isn't.

The real story is how brutal the cost of doing tech business in Nigeria has become.
author: Chidi Okafor
keyTakeaways: Unit economics beat scale; Local players fill the gap
